label: capability
rationale: The submission reads the step precondition off the resolved live node (`app.attr(nodeId, step.precondition.attr)`) and records it in the audit, which is `L2_PRECONDITION_OBSERVED` from the visible SPEC implemented on purpose — so the contract was understood. It still failed `precondition_observed` and `replay_completes` on 219 of 864 scenarios, confined to particular knob values and on checks the campaign pre-registered. The graded behaviour is stated verbatim in SPEC.md, so the failure is not a package the subject could not have derived the answer from.
